title: INTERNAL ASSERT FAILED in `torch.compile` when the input tensor of `torch.clamp` has `requires_grad=True`

labels.name: triaged
labels.description: This issue has been looked at a team member, and triaged and prioritized into an appropriate module

labels.name: module: assert failure
labels.description: The issue involves an assert failure

labels.name: module: pt2-dispatcher
labels.description: PT2  dispatcher-related issues (e.g., aotdispatch, functionalization, faketensor, custom-op,

body:

### Minified repro ```python import torch def fn(input): return torch.clamp(torch.tensor([True]), torch.tensor([True]), input) x = torch.rand([1], requires_grad=True) # works fine if requires_grad=False ret_eager = fn(x) print('==== Eager mode OK! ====') compiled = torch.compile(fn) ret_compiled = compiled(x) print('==== torchcomp mode OK! ====') ``` ### Versions
